description: Header file defining the PowerHalController class and related classes for managing Power HAL connections in Android. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and external dependencies related to power management.

classes.name: HalConnector
classes.description: Handles connection to the underlying Power HAL service, providing connect and reset methods.

classes.name: PowerHalController
classes.description: Manages Power HAL handle, including connection, reconnection, and thread safety, and provides methods to control power modes and hints.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the Power HAL.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the connection to the Power HAL.

methods.name: setBoost
methods.description: Sets a power boost with specified parameters.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Enables or disables a specific power mode.

methods.name: createHintSession
methods.description: Creates a new power hint session.

methods.name: getHintSessionPreferredRate
methods.description: Retrieves the preferred rate for hint sessions.

methods.name: processHalResult
methods.description: Processes the result of HAL operations.
